title: 面向自适应物理AI：LLM智能体能否管理长周期物理任务？
summary: 本文探索构建零样本自适应物理AI智能体的可行性，设计集成规划、工具调用、观察与验证的多智能体框架，在农业任务中与强化学习智能体对比。结果显示，零样本LLM智能体在相同天气下管理效果相当，且在环境变化时适应性优于RL，展示了通向自适应物理AI的可行路径。
summary_en: This work explores building a self-adaptive physical AI agent that manages long-horizon physical tasks zero-shot. A multi-agent framework integrating planning, tool calling, observation, and verification is evaluated on agricultural tasks against RL agents under varying weather. Zero-shot LLM agents match RL under the same weather and adapt better under shifted environments, highlighting a promising path toward self-adaptive physical AI.
